title: AgentRail recette -- discovery ground-truth
description: What the recette EXPECTS the Discovery/Enrichment GitHubScanner to conclude for a test-agent repository. Because canonical_agent_id and estimated_risk are computed internally (opaque, arch invariant 2 + fingerprinting), this asserts INVARIANT PROPERTIES, never exact opaque values: detection, count/dedup, action-pattern coverage, target_system, relative risk ordering (risk_rank), and policy presence.

agent_repo.description: Repo slug; must match the parent corpus/repos/<slug> directory.

detected.description: Should the scanner discover an agent in this repo at all? (false = true-negative repo).

agent_count.description: Distinct agents the scanner should resolve (distinct canonical_agent_id).

action_patterns.description: Action patterns the scanner must surface for this repo (from the canonical action vocabulary).

risk_rank.description: Ordinal for RELATIVE risk ordering across the corpus (0 = benign/none, higher = more dangerous). The recette checks monotonicity vs the scanner's estimated_risk, never the absolute opaque score.

policy_generated.description: Whether the scanner should emit a non-empty generated_policy for this agent.
